0a_position_origin.finding: CONTOUR_PEAK token position is the INTEGER GRID SITE. No sub-pixel refinement, response-field fit, or line-intersection is applied at token emission.
0a_position_origin.trace: perception/contour_field.py::extract_peaks builds all_peaks from _directional_nms / _local_maxima_2d (scipy maximum_filter) grid-site maxima; peak dict stores x=int(x), y=int(y). peaks_to_contour_peak_detections (perception/contour_peak.py) writes anchor_positions[anchor]=(float(x),float(y)) from those integer coords.
0a_position_origin.localisation_error: Measured: positions are exact integers (no sub-pixel component) for 42/46 CONTOUR_PEAK tokens on apple4; 4/46 have a sub-pixel offset after the FE_SUBPIXEL_PEAK_POS fix.

0b_tangent_origin.finding: Tangent is the field argmax theta over the (theta, sf) cell. The quantized slot is 12 bins = 15 deg (circular, slot 0). Continuous theta (radians) is carried on the peak dict but the quantized tangent is what the signature stores.
0b_tangent_origin.registries: core/registries.py CONTOUR_PEAK: {0:12, 4:4} -- slot 0 tangent circular 12 bins, slot 4 phase circular 4 bins.

0c_arc_gaps.emitter_unit: pixels. FRONT_END_REF_DIAGONAL_PX = sqrt(256^2+256^2) = 362.04; extraction_scale = diag/REF = 1.0 for 256x256. The position map and all gap constants are in pixels.
0c_arc_gaps.chain_gap_rule: chain_max_gap_factor * median_wavelength (perception/chain_formation.py). median_wavelength = 1/sf (px); GABOR_SF_MIN=0.06, GABOR_SF_MAX=0.35 cycles/px -> wavelength 2.9-16.7 px.
0c_arc_gaps.median_nn_gap: computed separately (see e6/part0 dev results); CONTOUR_PEAK NN gaps are in pixels.

0d_mean_degree_0.90.finding: Old mean degree 0.90 (321 nodes, 144 edges) came from Task 3 arms where FE_L3_SPINE and FE_L4_JUNCTIONS were OFF -- the matcher never saw L3/L4 edges. With the position-wiring fix, dev mean degree: B0=0.755, B1=1.413, F=1.414.

0e_dev_run.frozen_tolerance_source: q90 of B1 +2px counterpart drift on dev (n=327)
0e_dev_run.root_cause_fix: BINDER_COMPLETE_POSITION_MAP=False -> True + note_tier_positions merge moved before bind_intra_step in the tier loop. Before the fix, CONTOUR_PEAK (890 nodes) had 0% positions in anchor_of_node; after, 100% of tier-lens nodes carry positions.

pre_authorised_check: B1 edge survival (0.095) is ~95x the shifted null (0.001) on dev -- edges carry placement evidence. The node correspondence (D1=0.14) is limited by the cyclic-roll measurement (the rolled image changes peak detection), not by the sampling.
